label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: In ST I q.2 a.3 Aquinas states the conclusion of the…
locator: I q.2 a.3 co., prima via: quod a nullo movetur
interpretation: A claim about the wording: 'a nullo' is unqualified, and the relative clause carries no 'secundum quod' or 'inquantum movens' restriction. It does not by itself settle which reading of the per se premise Aquinas used.
